title_zh: 全红婵：十四岁的奥运冠军
title_en: Famous Chinese People (14/20): Quan Hongchan, Olympic Champion at Fourteen
note_en: 就 (jiù) after a time or age can mean "already, as early as": 十四岁就成为奥运冠军 "became an Olympic champion at just fourteen." It signals that something happened sooner than expected. Its opposite is 才 (cái) "not until": 她二十岁才出名 would mean "she didn't become famous until twenty." English uses words like "already" or "only," but Chinese puts 就 or 才 right before the verb.
